items.title: Pay remaining income tax 2024
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag von 1.238,00 € so, dass er spätestens am 22.07.2025 auf unserem Konto gutgeschrieben ist (Brandenburgische Musterkasse, IBAN DE49 1605 0000 0002 8700 00).
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar due date for the payment: the amount of 1,238.00 € must be credited to the Finanzamt's account by 22.07.2025 at the latest. A fixed calendar date in the letter is used as written and is not subject to weekend/holiday shifting rules (those apply to computed periods, not to stated dates); 22.07.2025 is a Tuesday in any case, so no adjustment would be needed regardless.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ein Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats zu erheben; der Tag, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wird, zählt dabei nicht mit.
items.computation: The letter gives a separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' of 24.06.2025 (Tuesday), which under the rules governs over the printed letter date (23.06.2025) as the start of the delivery fiction. Bekanntgabefiktion for a Finanzamt: delivery on the 4th day after posting = 24.06.2025 + 4 days = 28.06.2025 (Saturday). Because this is a tax office, if the 4th day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday it moves to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO) → Monday, 30.06.2025 is the day of deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). Per the letter and §108 Abs.1 AO/§187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of Bekanntgabe itself (30.06.2025) does not count; the one-month Einspruch period therefore runs from 30.06.2025 and ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number: 30.07.2025. 30.07.2025 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Brandenburg, so no further shift applies.
